title: News 12 Investigates: ECU professor explains how AI is helping military intelligence
hook_text: An algorithm is reshaping military intelligence.
script:
An algorithm is reshaping military intelligence by processing massive operational data in seconds.
East Carolina University assistant professor David Hart explains how these systems speed up defense analysis.
Analysts previously sifted through endless manual reports before machine learning entered the workflow.
Human commanders still keep final control over major strategic decisions and the use of force.
Who takes the blame when an autonomous battlefield decision fails?
